channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyreke Evans | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyreke Evans from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
McMillan on Evans:

“He went through practice, played some 4-on-4, felt a little better after he loosened up. It'll still be a game-time decision. We'll see how he responds tomorrow, have a shootaround in Atlanta and tell us where he's at.”

Nate McMillan on Tyreke Evans, Dec 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: David Fizdale on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
Peter Edmiston:David Fizdale on Tyreke Evans' minutes:

“I wouldn't say he's on a limitation, but at the same time, I've got to be really mindful of not overdoing it with him.”

David Fizdale on Tyreke Evans, Oct 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @peteredmiston.

item.title: Chris Wallace on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
“We are excited for Tyreke Evans to return to the city of Memphis and FedExForum, where he enjoyed so much success as a member of the Memphis Tigers,”

Chris Wallace on Tyreke Evans, Jul 10, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield
item.description:
“This is an exciting time for Pelicans fans as we continue our quest for long-term success. I know our fans are equally excited to welcome DeMarcus and Omri to our great city. I want to thank Mr. and Mrs. Benson, Dennis Lauscha and Mickey Loomis for their continued support and providing the resources for us to be successful. I’d also like to thank Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway and Buddy Hield for their professionalism and hard work on the court and in the community during their tenure in New Orleans.”

Omri Casspi on DeMarcus Cousins, Tyreke Evans, Langston Galloway, Buddy Hield, Feb 20, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
Brett Dawson:Anthony Davis:

“A lot of people think Tyreke wants to score, but he really doesn't. He wants to get his assists first.”

Anthony Davis on Tyreke Evans, Nov 30, 2015. Source: Twitter @BDawsonWrites.

item.title: Dell Demps on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
The New Orleans Pelicans acquired guard Tyreke Evans from the Sacramento Kings and center Jeff Withey from the Portland Trail Blazers in a three-team trade, it was announced today by General Manager Dell Demps.

“We are very excited to welcome Tyreke and Jeff to the Pelicans organization,”

Dell Demps on Tyreke Evans, Jul 10, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
DeMarcus Cousins on the team and, specifically, the dynamic between him and fourth-year guard Tyreke Evans:

“At the end of the day, everybody in that locker room knows this team is myself and Tyreke's. I don't give a [expletive] about no articles [asking whose team it is]. This team goes as far as we carry it.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Tyreke Evans, Oct 1, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Pete Carril on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
Princeton legend and longtime Kings consultant Pete Carril said the other night.

“Tyreke's got to learn to play without the ball. It's all there. I see some games, and he looks very good. Other games … he just has to work harder. I'd love to see him develop a mid-range game.”

Pete Carril on Tyreke Evans, Apr 22, 2012. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Andres Nocioni on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
Andres Nocioni on Tyreke Evans:

“I can't really say what I want to say because I'm on TV... Incredible talent, but I think teams sometimes should be tougher on the younger guys. What he brought to Sacramento was trouble in the locker room and that doesn't take you nowhere.”

Andres Nocioni on Tyreke Evans, Apr 15, 2012. Source: Canal Plus.

item.title: Paul Westphal on Tyreke Evans
item.description:
Kings coach Paul Westphal said.

“That's the way this league is. If you do one thing and it works and they find a way to stop it, then you have to have a Plan B. I think Tyreke's up for the challenge.”

Paul Westphal on Tyreke Evans, Sep 30, 2010. Source: Sacramento Bee.
